At the first book club meeting, all the new members met the two organizers - one was a 78-year-old, and the other a 22-year-old. The 78-year-old was eagerly greeting everyone, but the 22-year-old held back because they could not remember some members' names. Who was not forgetful?
A. The 22-year-old
B. The 78-year-old
C. Not known
